explication: SAW is a multi-provider AI-agent harness for applying team workflows through provider-specific instructions, commands, skills, and guardrails. The main user journey is to invoke a work command, then use role profiles and skills as the assistant carries out work; hooks provide automatic checks. The README also describes experimental multi-agent orchestration, persistent tmux-based Dark Factory teams, and a knowledge vault with drift detection and validation. The source excerpts primarily cover vault scripts; other relationships shown here are limited to README-documented capabilities.
